payload.title: Figure 1
payload.summary: The notebook aims to analyze emergent relationships in CMIP5 and CMIP6 climate model ensembles. It utilizes various scientific computing libraries to process and visualize climate data. The code includes functions for detrending time series data and calculating autocorrelation, which are used to assess the relationships within the climate model outputs. The notebook produces visualizations that compare these relationships across different climate model ensembles.
goals: Analyze emergent relationships in climate model ensembles

section_blurbs.blurb: This section introduces the purpose of the figure, which is to evaluate emergent relationships in CMIP5 and CMIP6 ensembles. It includes code for importing necessary libraries, setting plot styles, and defining functions for data processing and analysis.
section_blurbs.heading: Figure 1

inputs: Climate model data from CMIP5 and CMIP6
outputs: Visualizations of emergent relationships in climate models
